_comment: LGBTQIA+ Pride collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed lgbtqia-pride-flags` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_pride.py.

readme.title: LGBTQIA+ Pride
readme.summary: Pokemon wearing pride flags, the stripes running across the whole body (the transgender flag is collection #10).
looks: each line wears one flag: rainbow (Milcery, Ralts, Eternatus); bisexual (Fletchling, Rufflet, Pidove); pansexual (Indeedee, Ducklett, Binacle); lesbian (Zarude, Veluza, Sandile); asexual (Koffing, Rolycoly, Arctovish); nonbinary (Swinub, Cubchoo, Farfetch'd)
the original's light and shade stay inside each stripe; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: pastel glitter over the stripes and sparkles that twinkle in the dark
